description.value: A handcrafted log-home guest house in the Robson Valley near Tete Jaune Cache, offering two private suites each with en-suite bathroom and kitchenette. Situated between three mountain ranges and just a 10-minute drive from Mt. Robson, the highest peak in the Canadian Rockies. The area offers mountain biking and hiking, and the property can serve as a base for cyclists travelling the Yellowhead Highway corridor.

address.value: 12190 Crown Road, Tete Jaune Cache, BC
